cases.name: a_legacy_data_schema_with_arrays_and_nullable_bytes
cases.why: This schema declares flexibleVersions none, so its arrays carry int32 length prefixes and its nullable bytes carry int32 -1 — the legacy side of every choice the emitter makes. Kafka's own bytes are the only thing that proves this repository did not quietly treat a data schema as flexible.

cases.name: owned_partitions_and_a_null_rack
cases.why: v3 adds a nullable string to a schema that is not flexible, so null is int16 -1 rather than a varint 0, and the nested partition array is a legacy array inside a legacy array.
